strategy.summary: Advance the Bonus Grid to light the Pipeline lock, lock the ball, make the Plunge skill shot for three-ball Multiball, complete two lit shots for the Rapids Jackpot, then complete all five shots and return to Rapids for the Super Jackpot.

quickInfo.name: Bonus Grid
quickInfo.summary: The five slide shots advance grid columns whose rows and columns award features.

quickInfo.name: Pipeline lock
quickInfo.summary: Complete the bottom three grid rows or the Rapids column to light Multiball at the Pipeline.

quickInfo.name: Three-ball Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Lock at the Pipeline, then make the gentle Plunge skill shot to add the third ball.

quickInfo.name: Super Jackpot
quickInfo.summary: Complete all five lit major shots, then shoot the Rapids for 30,000,000.

quickInfo.name: Double Round
quickInfo.summary: Spell DOUBLE before Multiball to double most scoring and grid progress for the rest of the ball.

steps.text: Use a gentle plunge to enter the Plunge saucer. Watch the Rapids return to the right flipper.
Hit Pipeline, Rapids, Boomerang, all three Splash targets, and Whirlpool to advance their Bonus Grid columns. A lit inlane can advance one random column.
Complete the bottom three grid rows or the Rapids column. Shoot the Pipeline when Lock is lit.
modeNotes: Multiball qualification: The third row lights the Pipeline lock. The Rapids column lights it as a timed hurry-up.

steps.text: After the Pipeline lock, make the gentle Plunge skill shot to start three-ball Multiball. A miss starts two-ball play.
If Pipeline and Plunge awards complete D-O-U-B-L-E before the lock, start Multiball while rest-of-ball Double Round is active so its Jackpots and Super Jackpots score twice.
Shoot the two random lit major shots. Then shoot the Rapids for the Jackpot.
modeNotes: Jackpot phase: Two of Pipeline, Rapids, Boomerang, Whirlpool, and Arcade light first. Their completion lights the Rapids Jackpot.

steps.text: After the Jackpot, complete all five lit major shots. Shoot the Rapids for the Super Jackpot.
Repeat the five-shot cycle and Rapids Super Jackpot while at least two balls remain.

fallback.title: Direct grid Multiball
fallback.when: Use this plan when DOUBLE letters or the Pipeline advance shot are unsafe.

steps.text: Use the five slide shots and lit inlanes to complete the bottom three grid rows.
Shoot the lit Pipeline and make the Plunge skill shot.
Complete the two lit shots and collect the Rapids Jackpot.
Continue to the five-shot Super Jackpot only while the feeds remain controlled.
Start three-ball Multiball from the Pipeline lock and Plunge skill shot.
Complete the opening pair and Rapids Jackpot.
Complete all five major shots and collect the Rapids Super Jackpot.
Repeat the five-shot and Super cycle. Add Double Round before the start for the higher ceiling.

techniques.name: Plunge saucer skill shot
techniques.instruction: Plunge gently so the ball enters the Plunge saucer. A hard plunge enters the pop bumpers instead.

cautions.issue: The Souvenirs and Arcade targets are spring-loaded and return the ball with force.
cautions.response: Use them only when the grid or award value justifies the rebound. Keep both flippers ready.

cautions.issue: The Rapids-column Multiball light is a hurry-up and can expire.
cautions.response: Do not complete the column until the Pipeline shot is ready. Use the row-based lock when timing is safer.

strategy.simpleOverview: Surf 'n Safari uses five slide shots to fill a Bonus Grid and light the Pipeline lock. Complete the bottom rows or Rapids column, lock at Pipeline, then make the gentle Plunge skill shot for three-ball Multiball and complete all five lit shots before returning to Rapids for the Super Jackpot.
strategy.overview: Surf 'n Safari uses five slide shots to fill a Bonus Grid and light the Pipeline lock. Build the lock through the bottom rows or Rapids column, then start three-ball play and complete two lit shots for the Jackpot. Finish all five major shots and return to Rapids for the 30M Super Jackpot.

changes: With Tournament Mode set to YES, the top skill-shot saucer always scores 500K and outlanes score 100K instead of random awards.
With Tournament Mode set to NO, those awards use their original behavior.

steps.text: Hit Pipeline, Rapids, Boomerang, all three Splash targets, and Whirlpool to advance their Bonus Grid columns. Complete the bottom three rows or the Rapids column to light the Pipeline lock; the column award is timed.
Shoot the lit Pipeline lock. Make the gentle Plunge skill shot to start three-ball multiball; a miss starts two-ball play.

During multiball, complete the two lit major shots, then shoot Rapids for the Jackpot. Complete all five lit major shots and return to Rapids for the Super Jackpot. Repeat that five-shot cycle while at least two balls remain.

checkBeforePlay: These changes require Tournament Mode set to YES. With it set to NO, the saucer and outlanes use their original behavior.
